changes.behavior: Only first-transition identities query an existing NPZ path; queued identities remain checked and publication rechecks its output path. The run directory is owned by one recorder; unexpected external collisions during a pending episode fail at publication. Avoid repeated filesystem calls for continuing rows.

Retry an interrupted shutdown or future-result collection once, then drain known futures even if the executor handle was released earlier. Preserve the first exception and secondary cause. Repeated failure retains retry state and disables append. Enter closing state before any cleanup; append and context reentry remain blocked after inter-operation interruption until explicit close retry completes.

Reuse one fixed intp[N] environment-index array for row-order validation and action selection. Keep independently owned action outputs, metadata identity tracking and replanning rules. Add --metadata to the benchmark for consecutive identity tracking; retained index storage is extra persistent memory, not a whole-process memory reduction.

real_signals.scope: Real SIGINT and SIGTERM delivered to these isolated child-controller PIDs 20ms after entry into actual ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown thread joining while an actual writer is blocked. SIGTERM uses a test handler raising SystemExit143, not production default SIGTERM behavior. Candidate drains and closes before propagating the signal; baseline negative controls fail and are finalized by the harness. Owned native thread IDs and FD recovery checked; no signals to other jobs.

validation.style: ruff check and format --check passed for src/tests/benchmarks/examples; git diff --check passed

recorder_append.scope: Alternating exact baseline/final recorder append validation, owned copies and synchronous NPZ compression; N128T100 state, N16T50 RGBD32, N8T40 RGBD64, both episode formats. One warmup plus nine measured pairs. Excludes construction, physics/render, subsequent close and reader audit from timing. Three exact self-owned stress workers briefly paused, unrelated shared-host jobs unaffected; decoded payload hashes match. No async writers or synthetic noise in this benchmark.

filesystem_calls.scope: cProfile inside actual 100 synchronous legacy append calls, N128 timeout-only episodes; excludes construction, close and audit.

recorder_append_with_concurrent_stress.scope: Alternating baseline/candidate synchronous recorder append validation, owned copies and NPZ compression; excludes physics/render/construction/close/audit from timing. Seeded NumPy point task with timeout-only termination to ensure fixed full episode lengths. Actual read_episodes payload hashes match, both schemas, repeated cached local filesystem/shared host. One warmup pair per case excluded.

action_execution.scope: Alternating exact baseline/candidate ActionExecutor classes; precomputed policy chunks, optional consecutive metadata, separate allocation pass and owned-output checksums. One warmup plus nine measured pairs for executor cases. Full run_rollout cases include actual NumPy physics, task, sensor/reset work and optional raster, one warmup plus seven measured pairs; full transition hashes and summary equality verified. Excludes neural inference/training. Two recording stress workers concurrently active on shared host; traced bytes exclude construction, are not RSS, and cached IDs retain one intp[N] array per executor.

full_pipeline.scope: Alternating exact baseline/candidate recorder classes using full NumPy physics, raster RGB/depth64px, validation/copies, NPZ writing and final close, N4 T40 three cycles, 12MiB payload budget; synchronous and 1/2 writer threads, legacy/compact. Timeout-only task ensures fixed episode counts; synthetic-noise payload cases separately labelled. One warmup plus five measured pairs per case; public decoded hashes match. Shared host with three concurrent stress workers; results do not imply general training throughput or RSS limits.
full_pipeline.version: Earlier candidate before closing-state guard; diagnostic samples, not final-source end-to-end claims

quiet_pipeline.scope: Same N4 T40 three-cycle64px 12MiB full acquisition+writer-close workload as pipeline-comparison.json; one warmup plus nine timed pairs. Own recording/executor stress workers briefly paused; unrelated shared-host workloads unaffected. Hashes match, both schemas and 0/1/2 writers, synthetic noise separately labelled. Measures actual whole pipeline, excludes construction/read audit; no general training speedup claim.

recording.scope: Persistent isolated baseline/candidate NumPy VectorEnv recording and full decoded independent reference, byte-identical public data/window/batch hashes, legacy/compact, 0/1/2 background writers, state/RGB/depth, 8..128px, N1/3/16 capped3 for128px, variable episodes/history/horizon/shuffle, high unsigned/non-native identities, late-row invalid-step atomic retry and caller mutation. FD/thread equality checked after each case; sampled RSS is not a leak proof.

executor.scope: Baseline and cached-ID executor output and policy-call equivalence against independent Python-integer queue reference. Six signed/unsigned/native/non-native integer types, N1/3/16/128, H1/4/8, 0/2^53/2^63/full-range boundaries, repeated/skipped/wrapped steps, episode changes, local reset, noncontiguous canonical IDs, atomic noncanonical rejection and owned-output mutation. Fresh RNG per case; FD/threads checked each completed case, sampled RSS is not a leak proof.

earlier_recording_stage.reason: Added a closing-state guard after 12 reproducible inter-operation interruption failures; no recording parity failure

known_pauses.scope: Only exact-script self-owned stress worker PIDs, PID/start-time checked before every signal; no unrelated jobs. Goal wall time includes this real benchmark work. Data parent timeout45s, each pause limited30s with resume watchdog.

fault_cycles.scope: 500 fault-cycle invocations of eight tested cleanup scenarios, varying finite interruptions, writer counts, storage layouts and repeated-close boundaries. Actual thread-pool writers and NPZ publication; GC/weakrefs verify all recorder objects released after each case, and FD/Python threads return to baseline. Small point-state payloads only; RSS samples are not a general memory bound.

rejected_experiment.scope: Diagnostic conditional async-path prototype, not adopted. Repeat trials did not establish a stable advantage or a GIL scheduling cause.

limits: Append/executor improvements describe only the listed CPU workloads and scopes; no neural inference, GPU training or real-robot deployment speedup is claimed.
Full recording-pipeline timings vary across modes and repetitions, including negative cases. A uniform whole-pipeline speedup has not been established; all paired samples are retained.
FD and Python-thread equality are checked after each completed stress case; sampled RSS is not a leak proof or a hard memory budget.
Cleanup fault tests cover blocking shutdown/future-result waits and selected operation boundaries; they do not establish transactional cancellation at every bookkeeping bytecode.
SIGTERM test controllers install a handler raising SystemExit143; this does not claim cleanup under default process-killing SIGTERM behavior.
Optional dependency/asset test skips remain; full-suite counts apply to the recorded environments.

final_process_audit.scope: Read-only exact-run Python command-path audit; excludes this reporter and unrelated jobs. Long recording controller waits/reaps both worker children before exiting; signal harness waits every isolated controller.

evidence_archive.scope: Exact baseline source, final source excerpts, harnesses, raw measurements and logs; temporary synthetic datasets are regenerated by the scripts. Optional external SDK assets are not bundled.
